author: pikafuyu
quote: 13 years for this just for it to be full of bugs and everything else. There are plenty of comments saying it’s not the Game of the Year, yet it still gets a 99. This game is clearly bought and paid for; there’s no way it’s legitimate. It’s awful just like the users who enjoy this kind of thing. Disgusting.
